Tor runs in an external app (Orbot, say), set in Settings → Tor. Its logs are in that app.

This is an onion site, reachable only over Tor. The Tor client at %1$s (Settings → Tor) answers, but couldn\'t reach an onion site when Freedom last checked: its connection may be down or slow. Freedom is checking again; try again in a moment. Freedom never opens onion sites without Tor.

This is an onion site, reachable only over Tor. Freedom sends onion sites to the Tor proxy at %1$s (Settings → Tor), and no Tor client answers there right now. Start Orbot (or your Tor app), then try again. Freedom never opens onion sites without Tor.
This is an onion site, reachable only over Tor. Turn on Tor in Settings → Tor and start it, then try again. Only .onion sites use Tor; every other site connects directly.
